metadata.description: Reviewed AI-agent plugins for BoldCreate Connect: remote MCP servers developers use every day, a toolkit for the whole software delivery lifecycle, Syncfusion component skills, and community skill and agent packs.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Consult a stronger model at key checkpoints: before major decisions, when stuck on an error, and before declaring a task done. The advisor gets a full briefing plus the conversation transcript, returns guidance, and the main model keeps doing the work.
